I’ll trace the feature document’s claims into the current frontend/backend flow, then report the concrete cause, affected pieces, and a focused solution. I will not modify files.

id: F_455

status: design

---
see [action_agent_prompt.tsx](app/src/components/actions/agent/action_agent_prompt.tsx):

* why is it receiving responsePrompts and bottomRow as properties? There must be a very good reason why you wrote the code like this since it is an explicit rule not to do this in the code base.
* when there are 'questions':
  * the component rerenders 8 times, why? can't we improve this
  * the layout is wrong: the questions box always takes up all the available space except for the fixed height of the 'Prompt' box. the way it should work: the prompt box should be minimum size as long as the questions box has not reached the min-content (max-height), the prompt box should fill the remainder of the space and it's content (so the responses bar and markdown editor should use all available space.
* after any edit, for instance in a card, when we switch away from the application while an action popup was open, it will do a full reload 3 times (so with each reload, it will do all the rerenders as described above). This is very strange behavior, nothing changed on the action, yet is still reloads multiple times.
* same thing after closing or opening a card: totally unrelated action popups reload. this is not correct behavior, as nothing about the action popups has changed, no data it relies on has changed.

entries.content:
## Findings

- `responsePrompts` and `bottomRow` have no valid reuse justification. Their only production caller is `ActionPromptOwner`; they were passed as JSX merely to place them inside the prompt border. This violates the component ownership rule and prevents useful render isolation. See [action_agent_prompt.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/actions/agent/action_agent_prompt.tsx:16) and [action_prompt_owner.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/actions/agent/action_prompt_owner.tsx:172).

- The question layout regression is concrete. `ActionInputLayoutStore` calculates `questionsMaxHeight`, but the component ignores it and uses `maxHeight: fit-content`. The prompt also cannot expand while questions exist because it has `flex: 0 0 auto`. See [action_agent_prompt.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/actions/agent/action_agent_prompt.tsx:105).

- The eight renders come from several subscriptions in `ActionPromptOwner` and `ActionAgentPrompt`, followed by another layout publication from `setInput()` and measurements from `ResizeObserver`. Parent renders also recreate both JSX props. Development `StrictMode` doubles render-phase calls.

- The unrelated popup “reloads” are rerenders, not remounts. Popup entries retain stable keys and their runtime bindings survive. However, every `ActionPopup` subscribes to the complete project snapshot through `useProjectState()`. Any card edit, open/close operation, or filesystem refresh therefore rerenders every popup and its descendants. See [action_popup.tsx](C:/Users/janbo/Documents/dev/md2/app/src/components/actions/run/popup/action_popup.tsx:94).

- The focused test run produced 29 passing and 2 failing tests. Both failures confirm that the question height cap is currently ignored.

## Proposed solution

- Move prompt-box composition, phrase buttons, bottom row, and questions into `ActionPromptOwner`. Reduce `ActionAgentPrompt` to an editor-focused leaf component with no JSX props.
- Restore `layout.questionsMaxHeight`. Let questions use their natural height up to that cap, and let the prompt and editor flex into the remaining space. Preserve explicit resized-mode behavior separately.
- Replace `ActionPopup`’s whole-project subscription with granular subscriptions for the target card fields, project identity, and historical references. Put each subscription in the smallest component that renders it.
- Add regression tests proving that unrelated card changes do not render popup content and that question appearance causes only the necessary layout updates.

No files were changed.
